I work as a **Research Assistant** at [PenTAG](https://medicine.exeter.ac.uk/phss/research/pentag/).

I appraise health economic models submitted as part of health technology assessment (HTA) submissions to the National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) in the UK. I also conduct research on health economic modelling methods and applications.

For collaboration or to simple chat, reach out links 👇
